release_notes:
v2.3.2 — Shipping fixes and clearer labels

• Fixed: orders with a spelled-out country (e.g. "United States") were rejected when buying a shipping label
• Fixed: Ready to Ship and Mark Shipped could both be open at once, and Cancel could leave Mark Shipped stuck missing
• Confirm Shipped now stays disabled until a carrier and tracking number are actually entered
• Test Label and Print Test Label now work even when ShipStation can't issue a free test label — it buys and automatically refunds one instead
• Clearer one-line explanations under the shipping buttons so it's obvious what each one does
• New "Last Shipping Errors" tool in Settings for diagnosing a ShipStation problem without digging through the full Activity Log
